items.briefing:
Australian edtech platform Mathspace has confirmed a data breach affecting over one million people — if you or your staff use Mathspace, be alert for follow-up phishing emails or scams using your personal details. Separately, security experts are warning that AI is making social engineering attacks — where criminals manipulate people into handing over information or access — increasingly convincing and harder to detect. These threats are relevant to all staff, not just IT teams.

Researchers also warn that fully automated cyberattacks could become widespread within six months, meaning organisations need to review their defences now. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected message — even from a familiar name — verify the request through a separate channel before clicking links or sharing any information.

featured.title: Pronto adds AI tools to Xi ERP as it marks 50 years
featured.summary: Built-in generative, predictive and agentic features aim to cut manual work and sharpen forecasting for more than 1,500 Pronto Xi users.
